audit.whatIsWrong: The entry is built on the premise that Blinding Dart shuts Kennen down. Kennen's passive reads 'Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities' — Thundering Shuriken (Q), Lightning Rush (E) and Slicing Maelstrom (R) all apply Mark of the Storm as ability hits. Blind only suppresses basic attacks, so the only mark it denies is the Electrical Surge (W) auto-mark.
audit.why: A Teemo who believes blind cancels the stun will hold Q for the engage and then get stunned anyway. This is the single most load-bearing error in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Blind denies exactly one of Kennen's four mark sources (the W auto-mark). It delays three stacks; it never prevents them.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kennen.json (P: 'stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities'; Q/E/R all apply a Mark)

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and mid both claim you blind Kennen mid-Slicing Maelstrom to 'strip his on-hit marks off the channel'. R's bolts are ability damage and mark on their own.
audit.why: Blind has no interaction with R at all; telling the player to Q into the channel wastes the cooldown and keeps them inside the storm.
audit.corrected: Once R channels, leave its 550 range. Blind is irrelevant to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'mid' text says that at levels 4-5 'Blinding Shot is max-ranked' and 'your shrooms are filling the tribush and river brushes'.
audit.why: Q rank 5 needs level 9, and Noxious Trap is the ultimate — Teemo has zero mushrooms before level 6. Both claims describe a lane state that cannot exist.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5: Q rank 3 at best, no mushrooms at all. Control comes from range and Move Quick.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Lightning Rush as 'his escape' and gives no numbers; it omits Slicing Maelstrom's 120s, which is the actual matchup clock.
audit.why: Point 6 asks for the enemy's most punishable cooldown with the real window. R at 120s is the longest and most decisive one in the matchup.
audit.corrected: R 120s flat; Lightning Rush 10/9/8/7/6 at 80 energy; Teemo Q flat 7s at every rank.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Thundering Shuriken (950) out-ranges Blinding Dart (680) by 270 units, or that Teemo's Q cooldown is a flat 7 at every rank.
audit.why: These two numbers define the level-1 deficit and why ranking Q does not buy more blind uptime.
audit.corrected: Kennen Q 950 vs Teemo Q 680; Teemo Q cooldown is flat 7s at ranks 1-5.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] ('Blind (Q) his autos') and dontsFull[1] ('Get triple-stunned') both carry descriptions copied from unrelated template slots.
audit.why: The description under 'Get triple-stunned' talks about burning a cooldown for tiny value, which explains nothing about Mark of the Storm.
audit.corrected: Match each description to its own heading.

audit.why: Win rate 54.5% over 422 games is consistent with the level chart favouring Teemo through the mid stages.

edits.before: Your second Blinding Shot point shuts off his Electrical Surge on-hit autos and denies his mark-stacking rhythm, letting you out-poke a Kennen who relies on autos between Shurikens.
edits.after: Blinding Dart (Q) only denies the Electrical Surge auto-mark — Thundering Shuriken, Lightning Rush and R still stack Marks of the Storm as abilities, so blind delays the stun and never cancels it.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom is his kill window — he E-dashes in and channels R, stacking three Marks of the Storm into a stun-lock; time your blind so it fires the instant he closes, cancelling his on-hit marks mid-channel.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is his kill window — he Lightning Rushes in and channels R, whose own bolts stack the three Marks of the Storm; blind never touches ability marks, so step outside its 550 range instead of trying to Q through it.

edits.before: Hold Blinding Shot (Q) for the exact moment Kennen activates Electrical Surge (W) or E-dashes in, cancelling his on-hit mark stacking and his whole burst window
edits.after: Hold Blinding Dart (Q) for the moment Kennen steps up to auto — it stops only his Electrical Surge (W) auto-mark, so it buys tempo, not immunity to the stun

edits.before: Your second Blinding Shot point silences his Electrical Surge autos mid-trade, and a blinded Kennen who walks up to last-hit loses his entire mark-stacking window — you take over the lane here.
edits.after: Blinding Dart blocks his Electrical Surge auto-mark but none of his spells, and Q sits on a flat 7s cooldown at every rank — ranking it buys damage, never more blind uptime. Trade on that clock.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom is his biggest kill spike, but it needs a clean E-in to reach you — your shroom-slowed paths and Move Quick disengage mean you can kite the channel if you see the gap-close coming; blind the instant he arrives.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is his biggest kill spike and its bolts stack Marks of the Storm on their own, so blind does nothing once it channels — you beat it by not being inside his 550 range, using shroom-slowed paths and Move Quick to hold that gap.

edits.before: Kennen's Thundering Shuriken out-ranges your Q at level 1 and his Electrical Surge on-hit autos can chip you while your Blinding Shot is still a single point — respect that window, stay at max Q range, and do not walk up to auto a marked Kennen whose W proc is ready, because you will eat the return damage on your fragile body. Once you hit level 2 the whole lane flips: a single Blinding Shot shuts off every Electrical Surge auto he fires, stalling the third Mark of the Storm he needs to stun you. From here poke him with Toxic Shot autos between Q cooldowns, and if he steps up greedily to last-hit, fire Q the instant his W lights up and watch his burst window collapse to zero.
edits.after: Kennen's Thundering Shuriken reaches 950 against your 680 Blinding Dart, so at level 1 he pokes for free and you cannot answer — hold max range, take the CS, and do not walk up on a marked Kennen with Electrical Surge ready. From level 2 the lane tilts, but understand exactly what blind buys: it stops basic attacks, which here means only the Electrical Surge auto-mark. Thundering Shuriken, Lightning Rush and Slicing Maelstrom all apply Marks of the Storm as abilities and go straight through it. Blind therefore slows his path to three marks; it never blocks it. Poke with Toxic Shot autos between Q casts, fire Q when he steps up to last-hit, and count his marks — at two, leave.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your strongest sustained control window — Blinding Shot is max-ranked, your shrooms are filling the tribush and river brushes, and Kennen has no dash reliable enough to enter your zone without eating a blind or a slow. He will fish for a Q mark plus E-in combo, so track the Shuriken cooldown and hold your Q specifically for the Lightning Rush gap-close; a blinded Kennen who E-dashes into your poison autos takes a full Toxic Shot chain and can't auto back. At level 6 his Slicing Maelstrom is a real threat, but it requires him to already be inside melee range — deny that entry with Move Quick speed and shroom placement, and if he commits the E anyway, Q immediately to strip his Electrical Surge on-hit off the channel's mark stacking.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you have Blinding Dart at rank 3 at best — rank 5 needs level 9 — and no mushrooms at all, because Noxious Trap is the ultimate. Control here comes from range and Move Quick, not from a shroom net that does not exist yet. Kennen fishes for a Thundering Shuriken mark then Lightning Rush, which at 80 energy and a 10-down-to-6s cooldown is his only entry; hold Q for the moment he arrives so his Electrical Surge auto-mark is dead and your poison clock starts. At 6 his Slicing Maelstrom is not a melee threat — it works at 550 range and its own bolts stack all three Marks of the Storm, so blind is irrelevant once it channels. Deny the entry with Move Quick and body position, and once the storm is up leave the radius rather than fight through it.

edits.before: Build MR — poke war, blind his autos. Teemo wins the Lightning Rush cooldown windows.
edits.after: Build MR — poke war. Blind stops autos only; his marks come from spells. Kite the R.

edits.before: Q-blind erases his auto-trade window entirely. Only take the trade when Kennen's Lightning Rush is down.
edits.after: Q-blind kills only his auto-mark; his spells still trade. Step up when Lightning Rush is on cooldown.

edits.before: From 6 the shroom net makes his half of the map hostile terrain. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kennen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: From 6 shrooms make his half of the map hostile. Slicing Maelstrom is 120s and marks through blind — do not stand in its 550 range.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. Poke when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kennen Slicing Maelstrom: 120s, the real matchup clock — once it is spent you own the lane. - Lightning Rush 10/9/8/7/6, 80 energy: his only entry. - Your Q: flat 7s at every rank, so spend it on his step-up.

edits.before: AA Kennen on every last-hit, Q-blind his trade attempt, and walk the poison out of his reach.
edits.after: AA Kennen on every last-hit, Q his step-up so the auto-mark dies, and walk poison out of range.

edits.before: Kennen wastes Lightning Rush — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Blind stops his auto-mark only — Q, E and R still stack Storm marks.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three Marks of the Storm stun you; his abilities stack them, not autos.

notes: CHAMPION-WIDE DEFECT, not matchup-specific: champ-data/content/teemo.js writes Teemo's Q as "Blinding Shot" 271 times. This needs a single global replace by the applier, not 271 individual proposals — I only corrected the instances inside strings I was editing anyway.
